newsitem.title: CANADA: Bank Montreal plans C$250 mln debt issue.
newsitem.headline: Bank Montreal plans C$250 mln debt issue.

text.p: Bank of Montreal said on Thursday that it planned to issue C$250 million in series 24 debentures due in April, 2007.

The interest on this issue is payable semi-annually at a fixed rate of 6.05 percent until April, 2002, at which time the debentures become redeemable at the option of the Bank, Bank of Montreal said in a statement.
If the debentures are not redeemed, interest is payable at a floating rate equal to the rate on 90-day Bankers' Acceptances plus 1.00 percent for the five years remaining to maturity, the bank said.

Nesbitt Burns Inc served as lead underwriter on the issue, which is expected to close on January 30. The issue will add to the Bank's Tier 2 capital base. The Series 24 Debentures are not being offered or sold in the United States.
